sectors.trend: Mixed: iron ore weakness spreads (BHP, RIO, FMG under pressure) but gold (Auric, Golden Dragon, Forrestania, Gateway), copper (Flagship), silver (Patriot), and critical minerals for solar see strong price booms
sectors.implications: Diversify away from iron ore exposure; small/mid-cap WA gold and critical mineral names offer relative strength; copper upside supports Fortescue and South32

sectors.trend: Oil at US$100-101 on Iran war escalation; diesel hits 2022 record; Rubis upgrades guidance; coal-to-data-centre pivot by power giants; NSW power supply concerns
sectors.implications: Woodside, Santos, and oil services benefit from price spike; AGL/Origin face dual pressure from data centre demand and energy transition costs; diesel spike hits transport and agribusiness margins

sectors.trend: Bathla collapse ripples through private credit; RBA seen choosing recession; ATO opens tax fight with Big Tech; One Nation superannuation policy debate
sectors.implications: Big Four banks (CBA, NAB, ANZ, WBC) face rising credit risk and NPL pressure in a recession; private credit exposure a key vulnerability; super policy risk from One Nation

sectors.trend: Home buyer sentiment collapses; high-end property sees steepest falls; affordable housing resilient; Queenslanders migrating west boosting regional prices; NZ house crash echoes
sectors.implications: REITs (GPG, SPG, ICPL) face rental pressure in premium segments; construction and building sector weakened ('lost ability to build'); consumer staples (WES, WOW) relatively defensive

sectors.trend: AI data centre demand surging but straining energy grid; Austal US$1.9B bid; Intel $20B raise; AI stock risks flagged; Qantas $35M worker payout
sectors.implications: Austal (ASX:JCU) bid creates M&A catalyst; AI infrastructure names face energy constraints; Qantas (QAN) cost pressures persist

sectors.trend: No major ASX-specific catalysts today; CRISPR Therapeutics and Vitamin Shoppe news are US-listed
sectors.implications: CSL remains a defensive anchor; no sector-specific disruption

key_themes: Geopolitical oil shock: Iran war and Trump tariffs drive crude to US$100, threatening global growth and inflation
RBA recession dilemma: policy seen as choosing recession over inflation, weakening AUD and pressuring financials
Commodity bifurcation: iron ore weak vs gold/copper/critical minerals strong
Private credit contagion: Bathla collapse signals broader credit stress
Housing bifurcation: premium segment correcting, affordable resilient; sentiment at milestone lows
Energy transition vs AI demand: data centres at coal plants create policy and infrastructure tension
China-US friction: China's patience with Trump eroding, adding trade war risk to iron ore and commodity demand

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price shock and inflation resurgence
risk_assessment.mitigation: Hedge energy exposure; favour oil producers (WDS, STO) over consumers; monitor RBA response

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA recession path and credit deterioration
risk_assessment.mitigation: Reduce leverage; favour high-quality dividend payers; monitor NPL trends in banks
Review exposure to private credit and structured products; favour listed equities over illiquid alternatives

risk_assessment.risk_factor: China trade retaliation and iron ore demand
risk_assessment.mitigation: Diversify mining exposure away from pure iron ore; favour gold and critical minerals

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Housing market correction in premium segment
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid high-end REITs; favour affordable-housing and regional property plays
Monitor AGL/Origin capacity; favour renewable and nuclear-adjacent names

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight oil and gas producers on US$100 oil
opportunities.rationale: Iran war escalation and diesel record support sustained elevated crude; Rubis guidance upgrade confirms sector strength

opportunities.recommendation: Rotate into WA gold and critical mineral names
opportunities.rationale: Gold hits, copper surge, and solar critical mineral boom provide relative strength vs iron ore weakness

opportunities.recommendation: Position in Austal on US$1.9B bid
opportunities.rationale: M&A catalyst with clear premium; defence/shipbuilding tailwind

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt to consumer staples and healthcare
opportunities.rationale: Recession risk and sentiment collapse favour low-beta, essential-spending names

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore and pure-play China-exposed mining
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore trouble spreading; China patience with Trump eroding; demand risk elevated

defensive_moves.recommendation: De-risk private credit and high-yield structured exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Bathla collapse signals contagion risk in alternative credit markets

defensive_moves.recommendation: Trim high-end property and premium REIT exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Steepest price falls at top end; buyer sentiment at milestone lows; NZ crash as cautionary tale
RBA recession choice, oil import bill, and China friction weigh on AUD

market_outlook.short_term: ASX under pressure: oil at US$100, RBA recession narrative, Bathla credit shock, and collapsing buyer sentiment create a risk-off tape. Expect ^AXJO to test lower supports. Oil and gold names outperform; banks and iron ore lag. Volatility elevated.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautious: if Iran conflict de-escalates and oil normalises, growth names recover. Structural themes in critical minerals, gold, and AI infrastructure remain intact. Housing bifurcation persists. RBA likely to cut if recession materialises, supporting financials later. China trade risk is the key wildcard.
